summary: Rogers Communications filed a 6-K attaching a September 9, 2026 news release announcing the pricing of a US$1 billion US public offering of fixed-to-fixed rate subordinated notes (US$500 million of 7.150% and US$500 million of 7.400%, both due 2057) plus a Cdn$600 million Canadian private placement of 6.000% subordinated notes due 2057. Net proceeds of roughly US$990 million and Cdn$595 million will fund redemption or purchase of Rogers' 5.00% notes due 2081 and/or 5.25% notes due 2082. Both offerings are expected to close September 23, 2026. This is a routine refinancing capital-markets transaction, not a special situation.
